details.cross_half_policy: Eligible trades crossing 2009/2010 belong to combined D only; D is not independent of D1/D2.

pending_terminal_signal_limit.scope: The last unexecuted original signal is absent from the executed BASE ledger. Its saved feature values, codes, AND truth and pending status are crosschecked internally; no claim is made to independently recover that original signal or macro value. It creates no executed trade or realized return.

details.feature_validation_scope: All executed signal states match the immutable IS entry cache. Technical selected features also recomputed from IS-only source prices; macro direction/sign and strictly prior provenance checked against the cache. No new macro-data extraction is claimed.
details.audit_scope: IS-only pre-OOS audit. Historical reuse is not converted into untouched evidence.
